column2: [intro]
In my daily life, I'm rather plain,
But with my music, I shine like a gem,
I string together funny lines and catchy tunes,
The crowd can't help but smile and dance to the groove.
I want to be popular, the king of the stage,
Make the crowds dance and spark a craze,
With my funny songs, I’ll take them far,
Under the spotlight, I'm the number one star.
I write my lyrics with humor and flair,
Playing with words, rhymes, and tricks with care,
On stage, I clown around, having fun without a fuss,
And the audience follows, swept up in my whimsical rush.
I’m the clown of the song, the joker of the show,
Everyone needs my cheer, my playful glow,
Even on the darkest days, I'm here to brighten the way,
With my funny tunes, I’ll charm you every day.
[ solo ]
I want to be popular, the king of the stage,
Make the crowds dance and spark a craze,
With my funny songs, I’ll take them far,
Under the spotlight, I'm the number one star.
[outro]
